messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Some side effects were more common with particular conditions.
Sleepiness was more common in depression trials.
Insomnia and agitation were more common in OCD trials.
Constipation and agitation were more common in panic disorder trials.
Tiredness was more common in PTSD trials.
Insomnia, dizziness, tiredness, dry mouth, and a general feeling of being unwell were more common in social anxiety disorder trials.
In PMDD trials, sleepiness, dry mouth, dizziness, tiredness, and stomach pain were more common.
In these trials, 12% of people taking sertraline stopped treatment.
They stopped treatment because of a side effect.
This was compared with 4% of people taking placebo.
The most common reason for stopping was nausea (3%).
Diarrhea (2%) was another common reason for stopping.
Agitation (2%) was also a common reason for stopping.
Insomnia (2%) was a common reason for stopping.
Sexual side effects of sertraline:
SSRIs including sertraline can cause sexual problems.
In men, this can mean delayed ejaculation or being unable to ejaculate.
In men, this can also mean lower sex drive.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "has discontinuation rate", "12%"]

The relation 'has discontinuation rate' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has a rate of discontinuation specified by the object entity, typically expressed as a percentage of patients who stop treatment.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'discontinued rate': The percentage of patients who discontinued use of the subject drug.
B. 'has withdrawal symptom': Discontinuation of the subject drug may lead to the adverse effects specified by the object entity.
C. 'may have you stop taking': The subject entity may instruct the patient to discontinue the use of the object entity.
D. 'reduces effectiveness of': The subject drug may decrease the effectiveness or impact of the treatment or substance specified by the object entity.
E. 'has discontinued status': The subject drug is no longer available or has been discontinued in the region or country specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
